reference: M0, nominal radius .05 m, material r0=.0025 m

radial_pressure.method: Ten initial r0/a shells (lo,hi], upper-edge tie within 32 binary64 eps; nominal a=.05 m; positive native initial material volume weight per ID. FS2or3 uses current saved FSType, active only at t>tD. Empty group has no mean.
radial_pressure.timing: legacy_Tv=(t-tD)*legacy_cv/a^2. Requested Figure 7 Tv uses the closest actual saved clock only when within covered Tv; no interpolation. Peak is the sampled maximum of the fixed 18 centers at Tv>=.005 and tau<=.0625 s; neighbors within that window in CSV.
